author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: फलकामनां विना भजते स युक्ततमो मत इति ।  योगिष्वप्युत्तम इति मे मतः
translation: V. Shraddha or faith is Bhakti. He who has faith is considered Vukta i.e., a Yogi. He who worships Me with Bhakti is a greater Yogi. And he who without attachment to fruits with perfect resignation and faith worships me is the foremost of Yogis. Such is the distinction intended by the superlative affix in Vuktatama.
